# CONF-009: Undeclared client capabilities are never relied on

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/index#meta](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#meta) |

Calls each safe tool while declaring no client capabilities. A server MUST NOT send an input request (elicitation/create, sampling/createMessage, roots/list) the client has not declared (basic/patterns/mrtr#server-requirements-basic-workflow); when a request needs an undeclared capability it MUST return MissingRequiredClientCapabilityError (-32021) whose data.requiredCapabilities lists it, with HTTP 400. Tools are called only if marked readOnlyHint: true or destructiveHint: false (all tools with --allow-destructive), never if openWorldHint: true, with the minimal valid arguments built from their inputSchema. Skipped when no called tool exercises the rule.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-009`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-009"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
